# Date Picker

> A Date Field with a button that opens a Calendar in a popover, so the picker is the same in every browser and yours to style.

`<slab-date-picker>` · Form · built on `<input type=date>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/date-picker/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/date-picker.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-date-picker
  label="Start date"
  name="start"
  min="2026-01-01"
  required
></slab-date-picker>
```

It's [Date Field](date-field.md), so the input, the value, validity and the form all work the same. The browser's own picker is hidden where it can be, and the button beside the input opens a [Calendar](calendar.md) in a non-modal dialog named by the label. Firefox keeps its own calendar icon in the input, which can't be hidden.

Opening it focuses the selected day, or else today, kept between `min` and `max`. Picking a day sets the value, dispatches "input" and "change", closes the calendar and puts focus back on the button. `open` reflects whether it's open, and `showPicker()` and `hidePicker()` open and close it. Like a native input's, `showPicker()` only works from a user gesture, such as a click, and throws while it's disabled or read-only. The Calendar's parts are exported with the same names, so style its days with `::part(day)`, `::part(selected)` and the rest. `step` isn't passed to the Calendar, so a day it offers can still be a `stepMismatch`.

## Keyboard

| Key                  | What it does                                                                |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Alt+Down             | In the input, opens the calendar.                                           |
| Enter, Space         | On the button, opens or closes the calendar. On a day, picks it and closes. |
| Escape               | Closes the calendar without picking, and focuses the button.                |
| Arrows, Page Up/Down | Moves between days and months, as on Calendar.                              |
| Enter (in the input) | Submits the form.                                                           |

## Elements

### `<slab-date-picker>`

Import `slab-elements/date-picker.js` to register it.

A date picker with no visual styles: a Date Field, with a button beside its input that opens a Calendar in a popover, as in the APG's date picker dialog.

It's Date Field, so everything a Date Field does it does too: the native `<input type="date">` to type into, its value, `min`, `max`, `required`, validity, and taking part in a form. Only the picker is different. The browser's own is hidden where it can be, and Calendar is used instead, so the picker is the same in every browser and can be styled. Firefox keeps a calendar icon of its own in the input, which can't be hidden.

The button opens and closes a non-modal `role="dialog"`, named by the field's label, with a Calendar in it. The button says "Choose date" unless `button-label` is set, and is `aria-expanded` while the calendar is open. Alt+ArrowDown in the input opens it too. Opening it focuses the selected day, or else today, kept between `min` and `max`. Picking a day sets the value, dispatches "input" and "change" as typing does, closes the calendar, and puts focus back on the button. Escape and a click outside close it without picking anything, the way a native popover closes.

`week-start` is passed to the Calendar, and so are `min` and `max`, so days outside them can't be picked. `step` isn't: a day the Calendar offers can still be a `stepMismatch`. The Calendar's language is the field's nearest `lang`.

`open` reflects whether the calendar is open, and setting it opens or closes the calendar, as `showPicker()` and `hidePicker()` do.

Style the field through Date Field's parts and states, the button through `::part(button)` and `:host([open])`, the popover through `::part(popover)`, and the Calendar through its own parts, which are exported with the same names.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type                               | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `button-label`     | `string`                           |         | The button's text and so its accessible name. "Choose date" in English when unset.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `open`             | `boolean`                          | `false` | Whether the calendar is open, however it got there or went away. Setting it opens or closes the calendar.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `week-start`       | `number`                           | `0`     | The day the Calendar's weeks start on, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `label` (required) | `string`                           |         | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `autocomplete`     | `HTMLInputElement['autocomplete']` |         | What the browser may fill it with, as a native input's `autocomplete` says.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `disabled`         | `boolean`                          | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `hide-label`       | `boolean`                          | `false` | Hides the label visually and leaves it as the accessible name, for a design that shows the label some other way.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `max`              | `string`                           |         | The latest date allowed, as "yyyy-mm-dd".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `min`              | `string`                           |         | The earliest date allowed, as "yyyy-mm-dd". Also where `step` counts from.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `name`             | `string`                           | `''`    | The name its value is submitted under, as a native control's `name`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `readonly`         | `boolean`                          | `false` | Lets the user select the value but not change it, as `readonly` does a native input. The value is still submitted.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `required`         | `boolean`                          | `false` | Makes it invalid while it has no value, as `required` does a native control.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `step`             | `string`                           |         | In days, or "any". Counted from `min` when there is one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `value`            | `string`                           | `''`    | An ISO "yyyy-mm-dd" string. Like a native input, the attribute is the default value and the property is the current one, so the attribute doesn't change as the field is edited.                                                                                                                                           |
| `custom-validity`  | `string`                           |         | Makes it invalid with this message, as `setCustomValidity()` does, and shows the message at once rather than once validity is reported, for an error the page already knows about, such as one from a server. Removing it, or setting it to an empty string, makes it valid again, unless something else makes it invalid. |

#### Properties

| Name                            | Type                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `defaultValue`                  | `string`                  | The value it starts with, and goes back to when its form resets. It's the `value` attribute, as a native input's `defaultValue` is, so setting it sets the attribute, and `value` with it. |
| `form` (read-only)              | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The form it belongs to, or `null`.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `labels` (read-only)            | `NodeList`                | The `<label>` elements associated with it, as a native control's `labels`: each `<label for>` that names its `id`, and a `<label>` around it.                                              |
| `validationMessage` (read-only) | `string`                  | What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`, or else the browser's own. Empty while it's valid.                           |
| `validity` (read-only)          | `ValidityState`           | Its `ValidityState`, as a native control's.                                                                                                                                                |
| `willValidate` (read-only)      | `boolean`                 | Whether its validity is checked when its form submits. It isn't while it's disabled or read-only.                                                                                          |
| `valueAsDate`                   | `Date \| null`            | `value` as a `Date` at midnight UTC, or `null` when empty, as on a native input.                                                                                                           |

#### Methods

| Signature                                                         | Description                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkValidity(): boolean`                                        | Whether its value is valid. Dispatches "invalid" when it isn't, as a native control's does.                                                  |
| `click(): void`                                                   | Clicks it, as a native element's `click()` does.                                                                                             |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`                             | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                                              |
| `hidePicker(): void`                                              | Closes the calendar.                                                                                                                         |
| `reportValidity(): boolean`                                       | Whether its value is valid. When it isn't, dispatches "invalid" and shows the validity message, as a native control's does.                  |
| `resetValidityFeedback(): void`                                   | Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.                                                                                    |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string): void`                        | Makes it invalid with a message of your own, or valid again with an empty one, as a native control's does.                                   |
| `setValidity(flags?: ValidityStateFlags, message?: string): void` | Sets its validity and message, as `ElementInternals.setValidity()` does, for checks of your own beyond `setCustomValidity()`.                |
| `showPicker(): void`                                              | Opens the calendar and focuses its tabbable day. As a native input's, it throws without a user gesture, or while it's disabled or read-only. |

#### Events

| Name           | Type          | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `input`        | `Event`       | As the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.                                                                                    |
| `change`       | `Event`       | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.                                                                                  |
| `beforetoggle` | `ToggleEvent` | Before it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` that doesn't bubble. Cancel it while it's opening to keep it closed.                                                                      |
| `toggle`       | `ToggleEvent` | When it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` with `oldState` and `newState` that doesn't bubble, as a popover's does.                                                                    |
| `invalid`      | `Event`       | When a check finds its value invalid, as a native control's does. Cancel it to leave the validity message unshown, after a blur, a submit or `reportValidity()`, and focus where it is. |

#### Slots

| Name               | Type                | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description`      | `Element \| string` | Text that describes it, such as a hint or what the validity message means. It's its accessible description.                                                                                                                                                 |
| `validity-message` | `Element \| string` | Shown in place of the validity message's text while it's invalid and the message shows, for wording of your own, a translation, or a link. It's part of its accessible description, and `validationMessage` stays the browser's or `setCustomValidity()`'s. |

#### CSS parts

| Name               | Description                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `button`           | Opens and closes the calendar                                  |
| `calendar`         | The Calendar in the popover                                    |
| `control`          | The input and the button                                       |
| `description`      | Text about the field, and its validity message when it has one |
| `input`            | The input                                                      |
| `label`            | The label                                                      |
| `popover`          | The popover the Calendar is in                                 |
| `validity-message` | The validity message, which says why the value is invalid      |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                                                                                      |
| `:state(error)`    | While it's invalid and its validity message shows, which is once its validity is reported, as when its form is submitted. |
| `:state(open)`     | While it's open.                                                                                                          |
| `:state(readonly)` | While it's read-only.                                                                                                     |
| `:state(required)` | While it's required, for styles such as an asterisk.                                                                      |
